commitments.statement: Every Change without a completion or abandonment record offers Abandon Change in each of its Cockpit card details, outcome or publication, and completed or abandoned Changes offer it in none.

Delivery projects abandonment eligibility as an explicit abandon_available boolean on WorkItemDetailView, true exactly when the Change has neither a completion nor an abandonment record, and Cockpit gates the control only on that flag.

commitments.provenance: user request and source-observed existing behavior
commitments.statement: The reason field, confirmation dialog, abandon request body, failure feedback, Delivery abandonment rules, Pause and Resume controls, and Cockpit backend pass-through are unchanged.

acceptance: AC-001: Given a Delivery Change with no completion or abandonment record, WorkItemProjector.show_view returns abandon_available true for every outcome detail and, when present, the publication detail, including for a paused Change.
AC-002: Given a Delivery Change with an abandonment record or a completion record, WorkItemProjector.show_view returns abandon_available false for every outcome detail and the publication detail.

AC-003: Given a Cockpit outcome detail whose abandon_available is true, the detail shows exactly one Abandon Change control; entering a reason and confirming sends POST /api/changes/{change_id}/abandon with confirmed_abandonment true, the trimmed reason, and the detail snapshot_version as expected_frontier_digest.
AC-004: Given a Cockpit outcome or publication detail whose abandon_available is false or absent, no Abandon Change control is rendered.

AC-005: Given the existing publication-detail abandonment tests, including the failure case that keeps the confirmation dialog open with the error, they pass with fixtures that project abandon_available true.

AC-006: Given the changed sources, uv run pytest serve/delivery/tests/test_work_items.py passes, and in serve/cockpit/web the WorkPortfolio Vitest files, npx tsc -b, and Biome check scoped to the changed files through scripts/run-biome-check.mjs pass.

AC-007: Given the Cockpit HTTP detail route for an outcome of an in-delivery Change, the response item carries abandon_available true, and tests/test_cockpit_work_items.py and tests/test_cockpit_boundary.py pass with the field mirrored in the Cockpit WorkItemDetailView TypeScript interface.
outcomes.promise: The user can abandon any unfinished, not yet abandoned Change from any of its Cockpit card details with the same reason and confirmation flow, and never sees the control on completed or abandoned Changes.

tasks.title: Gate Cockpit Abandon Change control on abandon_available

evidence: Read-only Git independently resolved HEAD and the supplied branch to the candidate commit. Worktree status was clean. Inspected the complete diff_base..candidate diff and all 12 changed paths.

COM-001/COM-002, AC-001/AC-002: the flag defaults false and both detail branches derive it solely from absence of completion and abandonment records. [Projector](.owlbear/delivery/worktrees/cockpit-abandon-without-publication/serve/delivery/src/owlbear_delivery/work_items.py#L974). Regression assertions cover unfinished, paused, abandoned, and completed Changes.

AC-003/AC-004: the shared control requires abandon_available === true, regardless of card scope; false or absent suppresses it. Hooks precede the guard, and the component has one shared placement. [Control](.owlbear/delivery/worktrees/cockpit-abandon-without-publication/serve/cockpit/web/src/components/WorkItemDetail.tsx#L287).

AC-003/AC-005, COM-003: inspected outcome POST assertions, trimmed reason, confirmation, and publication failure retention. The request helper and snapshot-digest handoff are unchanged. [Outcome test](.owlbear/delivery/worktrees/cockpit-abandon-without-publication/serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/WorkPortfolio.part3.test.tsx#L340). [Failure test](.owlbear/delivery/worktrees/cockpit-abandon-without-publication/serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/WorkPortfolio.part3.test.tsx#L287).

AC-007: readiness enrichment preserves the projected field; Cockpit passes the model through. The real HTTP test asserts item.abandon_available=true, and the TypeScript interface mirrors the field. [HTTP test](.owlbear/delivery/worktrees/cockpit-abandon-without-publication/tests/test_cockpit_work_items.py#L1096). [Field preservation](.owlbear/delivery/worktrees/cockpit-abandon-without-publication/serve/delivery/src/owlbear_delivery/application_readiness.py#L710).

Complete diff inspection found no forbidden changes to Delivery abandonment rules, Cockpit backend routes/models, MCP serialization, or Pause/Resume controls. Scoped Git comparisons found no drift in the carried T1/T2 implementation and test slices. No material findings against OUT-001 or supplied task authority.

Tests, TypeScript compilation, and Biome were not rerun. AC-006 and executable portions of AC-007 rely on supplied carried evidence; this independent review establishes source/test inspection and Git applicability, not fresh execution.
